title: Friendly Robot Helpers

description: Practice AI, Machine Learning, and Internet of Things concepts from Friendly Robot Helpers -- voice assistants, self-driving cars, Indian AI pioneers, data types, pattern recognition, Teachable Machine, food-recognition AI, IoT basics, smart cities and smart home devices.
